name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 30 - Am 116
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 30 a. Emphasises the importance of robust and proactive public policies on disaster prevention across all Member States, including the regular maintenance and reinforcement of critical infrastructure such as dams and waterways; underlines that lessons learned from recent natural disasters highlight the need for continuous investment in prevention and maintenance to reduce future risks;
